channel.title: Software and IT services: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the software and it services sector.

item.title: Innosimulation: Innosimulation's market capitalization has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days, raising risk of administrative issue designation.
Obzen: Obzen signs KRW 4.68bn contract with LG CNS to build Shinhan Card's marketing platform and migrate AI Agent.
MediaZen: MediaZen's market capitalization has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days as of Nov 18, 2026, risking administrative issue designation.
Neorigin: Neorigin: largest shareholder of its corporate largest shareholder changes from Xi Zhu to Optimal Success Investments Limited via share transfer on 2026-11-18.
Softcamp: Softcamp's board decided to issue KRW 1.0bn of 0% unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, Series 3, maturing 30 November 2029.
CyberOne: CyberOne signed a KRW 4.11bn contract to support operations of the National Employment Computer Network cyber security control center.
Itoxi: Itoxi filed an objection on Nov 16, 2026 to the Corporate Review Committee's Oct 26 decision to delist its shares.
Itoxi: Itoxi's quarterly report shows revenue below KRW 300 million for the latest quarter, adding a ground for KOSDAQ listing eligibility review.
VAIV company: Vaiv Company decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 2,346,938 new common shares at KRW 1,274 per share, payment due 20 November 2026.
VAIV company: Vaiv Company resolved a KRW 5.0bn third-party private placement of 3,840,245 new common shares at KRW 1,302 per share to AI Blazer.
B2En: B2EN decides to issue KRW 10.0bn Series 7 private-placement convertible bonds, maturing 20 November 2029.
BRIDGETECCorp: Bridgetec signed a KRW 5.26bn contract with KT to rebuild BC Card's call center consultation system.
Itcencts: ITEN CTS subsidiary C Platform will absorb its wholly owned subsidiary 2KM Systems in a no-new-share merger, effective 2026-12-31.
Shinsegae Information & Communication: Shinsegae I&C's Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 176.9bn, operating profit KRW 16.2bn, up 29.03% year on year.
XIIlab: Xiilab board approved a KRW 10.0bn zero-coupon private convertible bond on Nov 6, 2026, for working capital.
KG Financial: KG Financial reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 71.1bn and operating profit of KRW 10.4bn, both up year on year.
FSN: FSN decided to issue KRW 3.0bn of Series 16 private convertible bonds for working capital, maturing 12 November 2029.
Lunit: Lunit decided to issue KRW 47.7bn of Series 3 unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 15,303.
Bitmax: Bitmax decided a third-party allotment of 13,961,520 new common shares to Korea Advanced Materials for an in-kind contribution of KRW 21.6bn.
Lotte Innovate: Lotte Innovate reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 284.0bn and operating profit of KRW 12.4bn, with a net loss of KRW 7.1bn.
